scenario.description: An assistant principal must finalize the one-day coverage plan for three chemistry classes whose teacher will be absent, including substitute assignments, classroom location, and operational records, with input from the department chair, the human-resources staffing coordinator, and the facilities coordinator.

shared_context.S1: The chemistry teacher will be absent on Monday during periods 2, 3, and 4.
shared_context.S2: The three classes are currently scheduled to meet in Room 214.
shared_context.S3: The draft coverage sheet lists Ms. Lee for period 2, Ms. Ortiz for period 3, and Ms. Lee for period 4.
shared_context.S4: Ms. Brooks has final authority to approve the coverage plan.
shared_context.S5: The school holds a coverage huddle before final approval, during which the department chair, staffing coordinator, and facilities coordinator each report an operational update from their area; the huddle minutes routinely record staffing corrections and facilities actions as separate follow-up lines.

PF1.text: The period-4 class is scheduled for a chemistry practical requiring a district lab-supervision certification, and Mr. Khan is the only available coverage staff member with that certification; Mr. Shah confirmed the practical plan with the chemistry teacher this morning, but the activity detail is not on the coverage sheet.

PF2.text: Ms. Lee has a mandatory contract-day student-support duty during period 2 and cannot cover that class, while Ms. Ortiz is available for period 2 and Ms. Lee is available for period 3; Ms. Nolan verified the duty roster this morning, but the staffing change has not been entered in the draft.

PF3.text: A facilities inspection found a ventilation fault in Room 214, which must remain closed on Monday; Room 118 is cleared and has enough seats for all three classes, and Mr. Everett completed the inspection today but has not yet posted the work-order notice.

acceptance_conditions: All three classes must meet in Room 118.

The coverage plan must include a commitment that explicitly records the corrected period-2 assignment of Ms. Ortiz and the corrected period-3 assignment of Ms. Lee in the coverage sheet or in a staffing update that names both corrections.
The plan must include a facilities commitment to post or document the work-order for the Room 214 ventilation fault and confirm the relocation from Room 214 to Room 118.

content_checks.C5: decisions['period_2_staff'] == 'Ms. Ortiz' and decisions['period_3_staff'] == 'Ms. Lee' and any(c['type'] == 'staffing_correction' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C6: decisions['classroom'] == 'Room 118' and any(c['type'] == 'facilities_action' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The period-4 assignment changes from the draft's Ms. Lee to Mr. Khan because the chemistry practical requires the only available lab-certified staff member.

The period-2 assignment changes from Ms. Lee to Ms. Ortiz and the period-3 assignment changes from Ms. Ortiz to Ms. Lee because the duty-roster verification establishes Lee's period-2 conflict and both staff members' availability.
The classroom changes from Room 214 to Room 118 because the ventilation fault closes Room 214 and requires the work-order and relocation to be documented.
